h1: Spark Ads Style Video You Can Post on TikTok
lead: A Spark-style clip is a tall phone video of your product. Place the photo in an everyday scene, post the file from your own TikTok account, and add the caption there.
steps_lead: You get a product clip for TikTok. Post it there, or send the same file to Facebook and Instagram.

steps.t: Make the Clip and Post It
steps.d: Make the clip, then post it to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram. Paying to promote it is a separate step in TikTok's ads tool.

faq.q: What is a Spark Ads style video?
faq.a: A tall phone video of your product. You post it from your own TikTok account, then allow TikTok to promote that post. This page makes the video. It does not set up the paid ad.

faq.q: How do I make the clip?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe one everyday action, choose a tall 9:16 frame and a length, then download.

faq.q: Does this publish a Spark Ad for me?
faq.a: You can send the finished clip to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram in one click. A paid promotion still has to be turned on in TikTok's ads tool.
TikTok sellers and teams who want product footage without booking a creator shoot, including food and electronics shops.

faq.q: Will it include captions or trending audio?
faq.a: Yes. Add a generated voice, and turn captions on in the editor, before you publish. A TikTok sound can still be attached in TikTok.
One clear photo with the full product visible and the detail the moment needs to show.

faq.q: Which size and length should I pick?
faq.a: 9:16 is the tall phone frame used for a full-screen TikTok post. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. A square 1:1 frame is there when the post is not full screen. So are 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4.

faq.q: Do I need to write a long script?
faq.a: No. Describe the point of the clip and the script writer drafts the words. Edit them, then make the clip.

Credits are the points that pay for a clip. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 seconds is 60, and 30 seconds is 120. You see the cost first. A failed run puts those credits back. Plans start at $24.50 a month.
Yes, after you post it from your own account and allow TikTok to promote that post. The download has no watermark. Any person on screen is a generated performer, not a customer.

faq.q: Can I post the clip beyond TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. Use a tall 9:16 frame, a square 1:1, or 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Then publish to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube.

faq.q: What if the job fails or the file is wrong?
faq.a: A failed run puts its credits back. If the file does not match what you asked for, use the [Refund Policy](/refunds).

faq.q: Can I use the download in my own ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads and posts. You are responsible for the claims you add and for logos in the photo you upload.
